text: {"lessons":["I waited through several periods before investing, then bought all five stocks at once; I should make allocation decisions deliberately rather than letting inaction turn into a single rushed move.","I sold some of my biggest winners while continuing to hold other positions; I should assess each stock on its merits, not sell just because a gain feels worth locking in or hold to avoid admitting a mistake.","A few months of account gains and losses did not make price moves predictable; I should keep risk and diversification aligned with my goals instead of reacting to short-term swings."]}
